protocol.timing: encoder costs excluded from these new request times;separate alreadycompleted32GBencodermeasurements retained. synchronized per-rank observer;report request/loading/denoising/AV/lifecycle separately;no purekernel-scalingclaim

guards.ownership: new exact parent reservation and unique child scopes;no unrelatedstops

timing_definitions.request: Graph construction/submission to polled successful histories on all participating ranks; includes disk/model loading, serialized rank arrival, denoising, AV decode/save and polling; excludes encoder preprocessing and server startup/teardown.
timing_definitions.sampler: GPU-synchronized KSAMPLER.sample wall spans. Both-ready window = latest sampler end minus latest sampler start; excludes earlier-rank arrival wait, includes implementation/collectives. Not a pure GPU-kernel metric.
timing_definitions.load_models_gpu: Sum of synchronized load_models_gpu calls per rank. Does not include all checkpoint parsing/materialization before this call. May nest in AV decode; phase columns are not additive.
timing_definitions.AV_decode: Sum of rank0 video/audio VAE.decode wall spans, including nested GPU loading; excludes some VAE setup and MP4 saving.
timing_definitions.lifecycle: Owned worker start through verified owned shutdown; excludes post-run CPU media validation and inter-run cooldown.

phase_timings.phase_definition: Per-rank GPU-synchronized call spans. Both-ready sampler span excludes earlier rank arrival while the other loads; includes actual sampler implementation/communication, not a pure kernel metric.

limits: One prompt/seed, 608x352x39 (1.625s), 20 steps; three fresh-server timed trials per arm. No maximum-capacity or long-video qualification.
Fresh servers with natural OS file caching/paging; not controlled cold-file or persistent-resident performance. These times exclude all text-encoder costs.
Common loader/source/conditioning/CPU seed narrows prior confounders, but one versus distributed rank lifecycle and numerics still differ. No GPU-count-only causal/kernel-scaling claim.
All full AV decodes pass; sampled frames show coherent teapot/wood/plant/steam, with steam-spout attachment only partial. No exhaustive motion, semantic audio or bitwise-parity qualification.
Memory/sensors are one-second sampled lifecycle observations, not guaranteed transient extrema. Scope memory.peak includes charged file cache; worker swap occupancy differs from whole-host swap I/O.
SMU thermal/hotspot/power flags are reported sample counts, including on the idle second card, not measured throttling time or proof of thermal causation.
Initial snapshot setup failures before generation remain classified as harness failures; no completed R2 trial is excluded beyond the planned two warmups.
